implementation_reviews.policy: Bounded local verification at named revisions. These checks do not promote portfolio states or establish deployment, adoption, or business outcomes.

reviews.title: Compiler-aware refactoring with guarded file changes
reviews.implementation: The TypeScript language service locates rename targets across files. Previews bind the intended edits to source hashes, limit the change scope, and check for new diagnostics before guarded application.
reviews.operations: Refuse a stale preview, lock the write, verify the resulting digest, and recover from partial failures while preserving concurrent edits.
reviews.verification: 24/24 tests passed locally at this revision: 8 compiler-aware refactoring, 10 guarded file-transaction, and 6 semantic symbol-knowledge tests. Node 24.22.1 with isolated TypeScript 5.8.3.
reviews.boundary: Temporary local fixtures verify these components. Portfolio classification remains REFERENCE_ONLY; no all-language CI, crash-safe transaction, production deployment, or customer outcome claim.

reviews.title: Recompile changed inputs without losing prior work
reviews.implementation: Bind generated application packets to source-content digests, reuse unchanged packets, and quarantine superseded artifacts before recompilation.
reviews.operations: Preserve prior lineage, distinguish stale work from current work, and write the input receipt atomically so a later run can make a defensible reuse decision.
reviews.verification: 3/3 freshness-aware batch tests passed locally at this revision: unchanged-input reuse, changed-input quarantine, and legacy-packet preservation.
reviews.boundary: Temporary local fixtures verify packet lifecycle behavior. No external application submission or production throughput is measured.

cases.title: Turn a complex workflow into a repeatable delivery system.
cases.problem: Company intelligence, candidate evidence, application state, and public hiring pages need to stay connected as the source changes.
cases.implementation: Build a Python control plane and a Node build pipeline that projects commit-pinned public data into HTML, structured JSON, and résumé surfaces.
cases.operations: Separate source ownership from presentation; reject inconsistent or unsafe inputs; validate the output before release; leave machine-readable state for the next operator.
cases.value: Makes a complicated workflow reproducible and gives reviewers a path from the presentation to its source.
cases.evidence: 911/911 tests plus lint, Protobuf, rollout, provenance and public-surface checks.
cases.boundary: Next gate: Refresh exact current-SHA receipt and generate all company dossiers.

cases.title: Recover an uncertain write before deciding to retry.
cases.problem: A provider may apply a write and lose the success response. Retrying blindly can repeat a side effect.
cases.implementation: Use provider-aware recovery, restart-readable evidence, and replay guards to reconcile an ambiguous execution.
cases.operations: Treat an unknown outcome as a decision to investigate. Read provider state, preserve the recovery trail, and block a repeat action once completion is established.
cases.value: Shows the judgment behind dependable automation: knowing when to act, when to inspect, and when to stop.
cases.evidence: Canonical 4a1ca8e5: 140/140 Node 22 tests; live GitHub Contents canary performed 2 writes/5 reads, recovered a deliberately lost success response to confirmed_applied, preserved restart-readable recovery evidence, and blocked replay before a third write.
cases.boundary: Next gate: Add a second real provider contract and multi-host coordination before any distributed or provider-transactional exactly-once claim.

cases.title: Make an agent action pass explicit execution gates.
cases.problem: An agent recommendation needs policy, evidence, drift, and replay checks before it can become an allowed action.
cases.implementation: Built and reproducibly tested an independent mission-agent assurance gateway combining content-bound public provenance snapshots, deterministic receipts, thread-safe single-process idempotency, finite-metric drift gating, policy decisions, and circuit breaking, using public mission-AI requirements as a bounded design lens.
cases.operations: Make refusal and failure visible; guard concurrent replays; reject invalid metrics; bind the result to an inspectable receipt.
cases.value: Turns operating requirements into executable checks and exposes the failure cases alongside the successful path.
cases.evidence: 17 recorded acceptance tests; proof state: REPRODUCED; implementation commit: 4328fa7078e6e4125f895768142c6af0c5ec1234.
cases.boundary: Independent single-process reference implementation. Excluded claims: Lockheed Martin deployment or adoption; Lockheed Martin affiliation, employment, endorsement, or contract; security clearance or proprietary access; distributed exactly-once semantics; production-scale distributed assurance; aerospace or defense certification; validation on classified or proprietary systems.
